meta.title: Drew County — the money trail
meta.note: This is Drew County's 2026 budget as filed with the state: Appropriation Ordinance 2025-20 and the department budget pages. We used the 2026 appropriation amounts. The county's emergency management office (OEM) budget includes a $36,025.43 'Transfer Out' line, so those dollars may also be counted in the fund that receives them.
